concerns.text: The three verified canonical sources (bio-datasets/dft23-full, sdmattpotter/dftest61523, dftest61623) are generic DFT parquet records with no indication they contain 2D crystal structures, CIF/structure columns, 6-component Voigt elastic tensors, space groups, or a 2D flag. The research block itself concedes: "whether they contain 2D crystal structures with complete elastic tensors ... is not guaranteed by their metadata." A plan whose primary data source almost certainly lacks every required variable is not a feasible plan — the abort-on-mismatch path means the entire pipeline (SC-001 through SC-006) is expected to halt at Phase 1. The spec's named canonical source (Materials Project) is descoped only because it lacks a verified URL this round; the plan should either (a) identify a verified dataset that plausibly matches the required schema (2D materials + elastic tensors), or (b) make the scope-revision path the explicit primary plan branch with a concrete decision gate before any implementation tasks are executed, rather than planning 12 tasks around a source that will predictably fail validation.

The plan does not state the fallback order among the three verified parquets (primary vs alternates) — "single canonical source per run" conflicts with listing two alternates without specifying when each is selected and how the choice is recorded for reproducibility (Constitution I). Specify the deterministic selection rule (e.g., primary first, alternate only on schema mismatch, choice + reason logged in data/raw metadata).
